name: propose_worker_replacement
description: Submits a remediation proposal to replace a confirmed unhealthy ECS worker task. Evaluated deterministically by the sovereign Remediation Broker against safety invariants R1-R8.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for ECS worker replacement proposal

incident_id.description: The incident identifier that triggered this proposal

action_id.description: The allowlisted catalog action identifier (strictly REPLACE_UNHEALTHY_ECS_WORKER)

target_task_arn.description: Full ARN of the confirmed stalled ECS task to replace
